reviews.author: Amara O.
reviews.text: Hands down the best cardamom knot and flat white in SE15. Friendly baristas even on a packed Saturday morning.

reviews.author: Leo G.
reviews.text: The chilli oil scrambled eggs on sourdough are unbeatable. Great spot two minutes from Peckham Rye station.

about: Bellenden Roastery & Bakery is a neighbourhood coffee shop and morning bakery three minutes from Peckham Rye station. We roast our house espresso in small batches each Tuesday and laminate our pastries by hand every morning — walk in for a quick flat white at the window or linger over brunch.
